name: Charlie "Blackcat" Smith
tagline: A true-hearted human obsessed with art and mechanism since childhood.
bio: Charlie "Blackcat" Smith is a true-hearted human being who has been obsessed with art and mechanism — and how it all works — since childhood. He's lived on both coasts and across the North, South, and Midwest, and considers his early years those of an American nomad.

He's now a visual artist, sculptor, flame-effects operator, metal fabricator, and dream producer based in Atlanta, GA, where he earned his BFA from the Atlanta College of Art (1988–1992). After an internship turned employment with mixed-media sculptor Carl André Davidt (Andre Studios, 1991–94), he dove into the film industry — set production and design, design-house specialty product development — building high-end fabrication and leadership skills as a crew lead and assistant to art directors.

Sparceland Studios emerged from the alchemy of those experiences, skills, and connections. Since 1997, countless projects have been conceived and manifested at this SW Atlanta studio — sculptural, design-build, architectural, art furniture, fine art, and more — and it remains a home where visiting artists grow and collaborative projects keep flowing.
